title: Global Multi-Maturity SPX-VIX Calibration Beyond Markovian Stitching
abstract: arXiv:2609.04087v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We develop a global framework for joint S&P 500 (SPX)-VIX smile calibration across multiple maturities without the conditional-independence restriction induced by Markovian stitching. Exact local and global feasibility are equivalent: every globally feasible law has a block-preserving SPX-Markovization that leaves each monthly $(S_i,V_i,S_{i+1})$ law unchanged. Nevertheless, stitched laws can form a strict subset of globally feasible path laws because Markovization discards dependence on earlier history beyond the current SPX level. Adjacent smiles therefore cannot identify this dependence, and laws with identical monthly calibrations can price multi-period claims differently. Under the standard Markov reference, relative entropy selects the stitched minimum-information completion; non-Markov dependence requires cross-period information, an appropriate objective, or a history-dependent prior. translated_title: 超越马尔可夫拼接的全局多期限SPX-VIX校准
translated_abstract: 我们开发了一个全局框架，用于在多个期限上对标普500（SPX）与VIX微笑曲线进行联合校准，且不受马尔可夫拼接所带来的条件独立性限制。精确的局部可行性与全局可行性是等价的：每一个全局可行的测度都拥有一个保持区块的SPX-马尔可夫化，使每个月度的 $(S_i,V_i,S_{i+1})$ 分布保持不变。然而，拼接得到的测度可能构成全局可行路径测度的一个真子集，因为马尔可夫化会丢弃当前SPX水平之外对更早历史的依赖。因此，相邻期限的微笑曲线无法识别这种依赖性，而具有相同月度校准结果的测度可能会对多期未定权益给出不同的定价。在标准的马尔可夫参考下，相对熵会选出拼接的最小信息补全；而非马尔可夫依赖性则需要跨期信息、适当的目标函数或依赖历史的先验。对于有限离散化情形，我们引入了一个……
tldr: 本文建立了跨多期限SPX-VIX联合校准的全局框架，证明局部与全局可行性等价、但拼接测度仅为全局可行测度的真子集，并指出相对熵在马尔可夫参考下只能选出拼接的最小信息补全，识别非马尔可夫依赖需要额外的跨期信息。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a global framework for joint multi-maturity SPX-VIX smile calibration, proving that local and global feasibility are equivalent while stitched laws form a strict subset of globally feasible laws, and showing that relative entropy under a Markov reference selects the stitched minimum-information completion, whereas non-Markov dependence requires cross-period information.
